subject: VM: Audit pulse & SOC 2 evidence handback for ThriveBank
messages:
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: thrivebank-security@thrivebank.com
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence + SOC 2 check-in for upcoming audit

Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on last week. Our SOC 2 auditor asked for up-to-date vulnerability management artifacts for the control tests: a recent authenticated scan summary, evidence of CVE triage/closure for high/critical items within your stated SLA, and confirmation of the monthly scan cadence you run against prod and edge services.

Quick asks:
- Can you provide a one-page summary and the exported scan index for the last run (format PDF or CSV)?
- A short attestation that any new critical CVEs in the last 30 days were triaged and either remediated or put in exception with owner and ETA.
- Any temporary exceptions or compensated controls in place for items still open.

We need these by EOD Mon (Aug 28) to feed the auditor packet. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Paul
Paul Reynolds
Sr. InfoSec Manager, ThriveBank
paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence + SOC 2 check-in for upcoming audit

Paul — thanks for the clear list. We're collating a concise packet and will include a signed attestation for SOC 2 controls. Attaching the latest authenticated scan summary and the delta index that maps findings to CVE IDs. Key points up-front:

- Scan cadence: monthly authenticated scans against the production fleet (last run 2028-08-20), weekly targeted scans for surface-exposed endpoints, and continuous CI/CD pre-merge SCA.
- SLA adherence: Past 90 days, our median time-to-fix for critical CVEs was 7 days; high severity median 14 days. We include ownership and remediation tickets in the CSV export.
- Outstanding exceptions: two low-risk third-party deps have temporary exceptions documented in the exception register; no open critical exceptions.

Attachments: thrivebank-scan-summary-20280820.pdf, delta-scan-snapshot-idx.txt, cve-closure-log-20280824.csv

If you want a one-page summary tailored to the auditor with explicit control IDs referenced (SOC2 CC4.x), we can produce that by Monday. Would you prefer a short cover letter or a signed PDF attestation?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Security Response
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Aug 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence + SOC 2 check-in for upcoming audit

Adding SLA clarification for the auditor:
- We define "critical" as CVSS >= 9.0 or exploitability confirmed in the wild. Critical ticket SLA is 14 calendar days from detection for full remediation or deployment of a compensating control; in-practice our median is 7 days as Marissa said.
- For exceptions: each has an assigned owner, mitigation plan, and an expiration reassessment at 30/60/90 days. I will attach the exception register excerpt if that helps.

I'll prepare a one-page attestation that includes the SLA table and the scan cadence bullets Marissa listed.

Ben Carter
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Aug 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Request: VM evidence + SOC 2 check-in for upcoming audit

Paul — attached is the signed attestation (soc2-vm-attestation-20280825.pdf) and the CVE closure export filtered for the last 30 days. A few operational notes for the auditor:

- Remediation proof: for closed criticals, we include PR links, deploy timestamps, and post-deploy scan evidence in the CSV column "closure_proof_link".
- Scan scope: authenticated agent-based scans run across control-plane and inference fleets; we exclude ephemeral test clusters with documented CI-only workloads.
- Risk acceptance: two exceptions (third-party lib X.2.3 and container runtime plugin Y) are accepted with compensating network-level ACLs; owners and reassess dates included.

Let me know if the auditor needs a short walkthrough of the CSV columns; happy to join the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@thrivebank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Aug 2028 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VM: Audit pulse & SOC 2 evidence handback for ThriveBank

Team — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. The auditor confirmed the packet is complete for control testing. Two small follow-ups: an explicit column for SLA aging per ticket (if you can add) and a short signed note that the exception reassessments are calendar-scheduled (not ad-hoc).

If you can drop those by tomorrow morning, we can mark the control as tested. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Paul
